title: Lithium Research Vault - cited narrative on any lithium mining company or mine,
description: Lithium Research Vault - cited narrative on any lithium mining company or mine, written only from primary-source vault data. Covers spodumene and brine producers across hardrock and brine cost curves: production, AISC, reserves, ownership, offtakes. Every sentence carries an inline citation resolving to a SEC/ASX/TSX filing URL. 40 operators and 49 mines incl. Greenbushes, Pilgangoora, Kings Mountain; tickers SGML, ALB, ATUSF. Same corpus as /vault ($0.05) and /vault/summary ($0.02).
